content:
maria: Canary for webchat-service on v2.3.1 showing 4.2% 5xx over last 10m, p95 latency +120ms. Sentry: https://sentry/issue/12345

deploy-bot: Canary deploy id=1890123000 -> 5% traffic. Health=degraded (5xx > 2%). See /deploy/1890123000

sam: Ack. Looks like model variant regression. Recommend unpinning v2.3.1 and route to fallback model redwood-latency-1. Runbook says rollback if >2% 5xx for 10m :exclamation:

kai: Agreed. Runbook link: https://rb/internal/runbooks/backout-models. Steps: 1) unpin, 2) staged routing 50%->100% 3) monitor metrics for 10m.

maria: I'll start the unpin. @ryan can you approve route change during the change window (ends 22:00 UTC)?

ryan: Approved. Staged rollout only. If errors persist after 15m escalate to oncall and open incident.

sam: Running command now:
```
rdwctl rollout --service webchat --action unpin --from 2.3.1 --to 2.3.0 --fallback redwood-latency-1 --staged 50,100 --wait 180
```

deploy-bot: Action queued: unpin v2.3.1 -> pin v2.3.0 (staged 50% at t+0m, 100% at t+3m). Operator=sam

maria: Monitoring metrics: 5xx dropping to 1.1% after first stage, p95 back down ~80ms. Good sign.

sam: Second stage complete -> 100% traffic to v2.3.0/fallback. Confirming traces look healthy.

kai: Running quick smoke: logs show decreased exceptions, latency normalized. Hold on for 10m then mark stable.

ryan: Noted. Please file change summary in release notes and link runbook. 

maria: Filed an entry in the release notes: "rollback-unpin-1890123456: Canary on v2.3.1 degraded -> unpinned to v2.3.0, staged fallback to redwood-latency-1. Metrics stabilized within 10m." Closing thread after 30m stable.

sam: Adding follow-up checklist:
- Confirmed rollback completed
- Alerts cleared
- Postmortem if >30m impact
- Repro steps captured

maria: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
